Kevin Trudeau's first big infomercial broke every rule in the book: no product shots, no testimonials, no script, no teleprompter, shot live in one take.

It started pulling a four, five, six-to-one return - unheard of at the time. Ron Popeil himself tracked him down and asked how he was spending a million dollars a week in media and still making money. Kevin told him the ratio. Ron told him he was lying.

The media buyer standing right there - who actually bought the ad time - stepped in and backed the number. The whole room went silent.

Sometimes the biggest proof you're onto something is that the experts refuse to believe it.

#kevintrudeau #marketing #advertising #success #business #mindset

Kevin Trudeau ran a classified ad in the 1970s. It flopped - almost no replies, almost no orders.

A few weeks later he ran the exact same ad. He changed one word.

The mailman started showing up with a bag full of inquiries - before he could even get the last batch out of the mailbox. He had to call friends over just to help stuff envelopes on the kitchen table. Within days it was two mail bags, and the letters weren't just inquiries anymore - they were orders, with cash and money orders inside.

One word. That's the whole difference between an ad nobody answers and one that buries you in mail.

#kevintrudeau #copywriting #marketing #directmail #success #mindset

A UPS driver kept failing at the side business he wanted to build. Kevin Trudeau worked with him on whatever was blocking him - and his company went on to do $150 million in sales.

Another guy was sleeping on a mattress in his mother-in-law's house, flipping pizzas at a pizza joint. He tracked Kevin down and said he wanted in on the infomercial business. His first attempt failed too. After the same work, his company did over $200 million in sales.

A third guy, in the UK, built a company now doing 250 million pounds a year.

Same starting point as almost everyone else. Different result once whatever was in the way got cleared out.

#kevintrudeau #success #entrepreneur #wealthmindset #mindset #business

Zig Ziglar spoke two hours, then sold for thirty minutes. Brian Tracy did the same, then sold for forty-five. By the time Kevin Trudeau got on stage, the room had already spent its money.

His pitch: one line, the course was in the back for $89, and there wasn't enough for everyone - first come, first served. People got up and ran.

He outsold Zig Ziglar, Brian Tracy and Charlie 'Tremendous' Jones combined, two to one, with a thirty-second close against their forty-five minutes.

Zig Ziglar asked him to dinner that night just to find out how.

#kevintrudeau #sales #marketing #zigziglar #success #mindset

Everyone skips the first step of manifesting money, Kevin Trudeau says - and it isn't visualization.

It's finding the actual pain. Wanting $100,000 a month isn't the same as needing it. Most people are only wishing.

He learned the difference the hard way: a mentor grabbed him in a pool and held him under the water until he was genuinely desperate to breathe. When he came up, the lesson was simple - when you want something exactly that badly, that's when you get it.

Most goals fail right there, before any strategy even matters.

How badly do you actually want what you say you want?

#kevintrudeau #manifesting #mindset #yourwishisyourcommand #lawofattraction #goals
